sources.locator: Page 1 title block (RUILON ELECTRONICS logo, 'Please refer to http://www.ruilon.com for current information') and Page 2 Performance Specification table, row SMD1210P200TF
sources.evidence_extract: Manufacturer datasheet (retrieved via LCSC's datasheet.lcsc.com PDF host; title block bears the RUILON ELECTRONICS logo and directs readers to ruilon.com; File Number SP-PTC-007, Version A4/2026-03-11 printed on every page footer). Page 2 Performance Specification table, row 'SMD1210P200TF' (marking RZ): Ihold=2.00A, Itrip=4.00A, Vmax=6 VDC, Max Time to Trip Current=8.00A/Tmax=1.00S, Imax=35A, Pd typ=0.8W, Rimin=0.015 ohm, R1max=0.07 ohm, Package=1210. This row carries no '/xx' voltage-suffix (the RUILON SMD1210 family encodes higher special-voltage variants as e.g. 'SMD1210P150TF/16' and 'SMD1210P110TF/16'; SMD1210P200TF has no such suffixed sibling in this table and is the exact orderable matching LCSC C20808). Page 1 Environmental Specifications table: passive aging +85C/1000hrs ~5% typical resistance change, humidity aging +85C/85%RH/168h ~5% typical, thermal shock +85C to -40C x20 ~33% typical, resistance to solvent/vibration per MIL-STD-202 no change; ambient operating conditions -40C to +85C; maximum device surface temperature in tripped state 125C. Page 3 Thermal Derating Chart-Ih(A) table, row SMD1210P200TF, 85C ambient column = 0.98A. LCSC's own C20808 product listing independently states 'Polymeric PTC Resettable Fuse 6V 2A Surface Mount 1210', corroborating the 6V Vmax rating read from this table.

sources.locator: Page 2 Performance Specification table, row SMD1210P150TF/16 (the 16V special-voltage suffixed sibling of the SMD1210P200TF row); Page 1 title block (RUILON ELECTRONICS logo)
sources.evidence_extract: Same retained RUILON SMD1210 Series family datasheet as src-ptc1-smd1210-datasheet (File Number SP-PTC-007, Version A4/2026-03-11; identical retained PDF, identical SHA-256). Its Page 2 Performance Specification table encodes higher special-voltage variants with a '/xx' suffix, including the row 'SMD1210P150TF/16': Ihold=1.50A, Itrip=3.00A, Vmax=16 VDC, Package=1210. These row values are independently corroborated by the LCSC C7529589 product listing ('PTC RESET FUSE 16V 1.5A 1210, RUILON', dated API observation 2026-08-14 recorded in scripts/schgen/decisions.json dec-g-ptc1-replacement) and by the project's components/ptc-12v.md page, which documents this exact orderable (C7529589) with the same 1.5A hold / 3.0A trip / 16V maximum voltage figures. The Page 3 Thermal Derating Chart-Ih(A) table has no retained row for the /16 suffixed variant, so no 85C derated hold figure is recorded for this part.
